name: Medicines
duplicates: The old Figma (健康与治疗) has no medicine list: a drug name is typed on each treatment. Before this feature, Record treatment's medicine picker (health-record.medicine-picker) and its Brand field held a sample catalogue.

entryPoints.label: Record treatment for several pigs, Medicine field
A vaccination task on a pig, Vaccine field

addsTo.what: A Medicines row (the farm's medicine list: rename and delete products)
The Medicine field of Record treatment and Record vaccination opens this picker; Method and unit are pre-filled from the product

flow: type a name with no match
type a new medicine, tap Add

screens.name: Choose a medicine: recent, then categories
screens.zh: 选择药品：最近使用与分类

notes.purpose: Pick what was given, over the real Record treatment page: search, the farm's recent products, then the categories.

elements.name: Recently used
elements.shows: Up to three products the farm picked last, under the group label Recently used

states.when: The farm has recorded a treatment
states.shows: Brand, then medicine · form; a medicine given with its brand not known reads the medicine, then Brand not known

states.when: Nothing recorded yet, or none fits the task
states.shows: The block is absent; the categories lose their label (medicines.picker-first)

elements.logic: Distinct, newest first, any worker, filtered to the task (a vaccination shows vaccines only). A product deleted from the list leaves it.

elements.name: Category rows
elements.shows: The fixed category list, the same on every farm
elements.rule: Categories carry no count. A tap opens the category as a level; the footer Back comes back here, the ✕ closes the picker.

rules: A pick commits and closes; the field shows the product (Metacam · injection) or the medicine alone for Brand not known.
issues: The medicine list is sample data from pig farming, not a farm's real list and not a treatment recommendation.

screens.name: Choose a medicine: no recent picks

notes.purpose: The picker on a farm that has recorded no treatment yet: search, then the categories with no group label.

screens.name: A category: medicines and their products

notes.purpose: One flat list: each medicine is a group label, its products are the rows, Brand not known is the last row of each.

elements.name: Title
elements.rule: Pain relief and anti-inflammatory, Hormones and reproduction, and Vitamins, minerals and iron take short titles (Pain relief, Hormones, Vitamins and iron) to fit the header at 360 (budget.md).

elements.name: Product row
elements.shows: Brand, with the form as its second line

states.shows: The name alone (adding asks no form)

elements.name: Search
elements.rule: Searches every category from here; while it has text the head names the root (Medicines). The footer Back goes up to Medicines.

notes.purpose: Results laid out as a category is: medicine labels, product rows.

elements.name: Results
elements.logic: A match on a medicine or an ingredient lists all its products and Brand not known; a match on a brand lists only that brand's products. Only the task's categories are searched.

notes.purpose: The same picker filtered to Vaccines: recent vaccines, then the vaccines by disease.

elements.name: Vaccine list
elements.shows: One category left, so its medicines are listed at once (no one-row category level)
elements.logic: Recents and search are filtered to Vaccines; adding files a new vaccine under Vaccines.

notes.purpose: Nothing matches: one card, Add “Zactran”, and nothing else.
Name (pre-filled from the search) and Medicine; Category only when the medicine is new.

elements.name: Add
elements.rule: Waits until Name and Medicine are set (and Category for a new medicine); a tap while waiting marks them Required. Adding puts the product into the farm's list for everyone at once and picks it: the drawer closes on the form.

states.when: The search was typed at a category
states.shows: Its level lists that category's medicines; a new one is filed there

states.when: The search was typed at the root
states.shows: Every medicine, under its category's label

rules: Nothing else is asked: method, dose and unit are recorded on each treatment.

screens.name: Add a product: choose its medicine

notes.purpose: Pick the medicine the new product is, or type a new one (Add “…” when nothing matches).

screens.name: Add a product: a new medicine asks its category
screens.zh: 添加产品：新药品需选分类

notes.purpose: A medicine typed new adds the Category field.
The farm's medicine list, by category: where products are renamed and deleted. Reached from Home → Toolbox → Medicines (not built on Home yet).
issues: The Toolbox row on Home is not built (addsTo, added: false).

notes.purpose: A category's medicines (group labels) and their products (rows).

elements.name: Medicine group
elements.shows: The medicine's name over its products

states.shows: Absent: Brand not known is not a product

issues: Who may rename and delete is a product rule to confirm (the prototype lets anyone).

notes.purpose: The product's name, pre-filled; Rename waits until it changes.

elements.name: Rename
elements.rule: Renames the product in the picker and on this page for everyone; past records keep the name they were saved with.

notes.purpose: Asks first, and says what happens to past records.

elements.name: Delete
elements.rule: Takes the product off the picker, the recent picks and this page; past records keep its name. Its medicine stays (Brand not known).
